listedAsset.description: Asset ticker OFAC lists for this address, e.g. ETH, XBT, USDT

sanctioned.description: true only on an exact match with an OFAC SDN Digital Currency Address

verdict.description: block = do not transact; no_match = not on the SDN address list (not a safety guarantee)

description: Screens a crypto wallet address (EVM, BTC, TRON, SOL, XMR and every other chain OFAC lists) against all Digital Currency Addresses on the US Treasury OFAC SDN list. Returns sanctioned true/false, verdict block/no_match, SDN entity name, sdnType, programs and the list publish date. Use when an agent is about to send funds to, pay, or accept funds from an unfamiliar wallet. $0.01 USDC on Base. Paid tool: call it once to get the x402 PaymentRequired object, then retry with params._meta["x402/payment"].

address.description: Wallet address. EVM 0x... (case-insensitive), BTC 1.../3.../bc1..., TRON T..., Solana base58, etc.

name: ofac_wallet_screen
title: OFAC SDN Wallet Screen
